name: 80210 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80210 (Denver) has 228 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 98 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80210 (Denver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
